frame: ship axes: +X bow, az from +Y toward +Z, metres, tonnes, kN
ownership_rule: ISSA owns machinery, its supports (saddles, slides, rack brackets, rail chairs) and utilities; PSA owns primary load-bearing structure (frames, longerons, decks, hoops, bearings) and the loads they carry; a mount id is the boundary between them

load_cases.notes: operating values, not limit loads: PSA applies its factors
